name: drop-box-cli
title: Drop Box CLI
description: Upload files selected in Finder to an SSH server and copy their remote paths
author: vaxann

commands.name: upload-finder-selection
commands.title: Upload Finder Selection
commands.subtitle: drop-box-cli
commands.description: Pick a server and a directory, upload the files selected in Finder and copy their remote paths.

commands.name: upload-to-last-destination
commands.title: Upload to Last Destination
commands.subtitle: drop-box-cli
commands.description: Upload the files selected in Finder to the most recently used server and directory.

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: drop-box-cli Path
preferences.description: Path to the drop-box-cli binary. Leave empty to look in /usr/local/bin, ~/.local/bin, ~/go/bin and /opt/homebrew/bin.
